messages:
jordan: Quick sync — we need one tight pass on homepage + Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing lines before webinar planning next Wed. Goals: 1) clear mode differentiation, 2) three launch posts (benchmark narrative, customer migration, dev quickstart), 3) webinar hooks tied to each audience, 4) inbound routing mapping for MQL -> SDR -> AE. Thoughts?

riley: Love it. Can we do 2 hero variants to A/B: 'Performance-first inference' and 'Predictable inference economics'. I can mock both by EOD Tue.

sam: For launch posts, sequence idea: Benchmark deep-dive (latency & cost charts) -> Customer migration story (savings & ops) -> Developer quickstart (5-min to prod). Tailor hero lines per mode.

mia: On inbound routing: propose required form fields: use-case, data sensitivity (yes/no), expected qps, decision timeline. Map data_sensitivity=yes -> Private -> enterprise rep. I'll draft a routing matrix and persona mapping.

alex: Timeline + metrics we should track: CTR, demo signups, SQL conversion rate. Recommend 2-week A/B test after launch. Owner: jordan. @riley owns creative mocks.

ava: Small but important: don't publish absolute perf numbers unless eng-ml vets them. Use safe language like 'up to' and link to benchmark page. I'll coordinate with eng-ml to certify any claims.

jordan: Agreed. Draft hero lines (short, feel testable):
- Hosted: 'Start fast with a managed LLM API — predictable pricing, instant scale.'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and isolation.'
- Private: 'Bring inference inside your VPC or on-prem for regulated data.'

riley: Micro-variants for tone tests:
- Hosted alt: 'Launch LLM features in hours, not weeks.'
- Dedicated alt: 'Committed capacity. Consistent tail-latency.'
- Private alt: 'Complete control, enterprise-grade security.'

sam: Webinar hooks (3, audience-targeted):
1) 'Benchmark deep-dive: how we measured cost-per-1k tokens across modes' — infra/ops audience.
2) 'Customer migration: hosted -> dedicated -> private' — success/ops audience.
3) 'Hands-on dev workshop: realtime chat, streaming, and graceful fallbacks' — developer audience.

mia: Draft inbound routing pseudo-config (gives engineering a clear map):
```
routes:
  - if: form.data_sensitivity == 'high' -> team: 'enterprise-sales', lead_tier: 'A'
  - if: form.qps >= 500 -> team: 'solutions', note: 'scale-need'
  - if: form.trial_credits_used >= 1000 -> team: 'growth', lead_tier: 'B'
  - else -> team: 'sdg-inbound'
```
(we'll convert to actual CRM workflow once we pick vendor fields)

jordan: Nice. Also want short CTA ladder per page: Hosted -> 'Try Hosted API' (self-serve), Dedicated -> 'Request Dedicated eval', Private -> 'Contact sales for private deployment'. Keep CTAs distinct and measurable.

riley: I'll wireframe hero + CTA combos and drop PNGs in the notion page. :+1: 

sam: I'll draft the benchmark post outline and suggest 3 key charts (latency tail, cost/unit, throughput per GPU). Will call out methodology for transparency.

mia: I'll map the routing matrix into a Google Sheet and include the form copy with conditional fields.

ava: Eng-ML will validate bench numbers; ETA Wed noon. We should avoid percent claims without CI.

alex: Also add UTM tagging plan for the three launch posts and webinar invites. Suggest utm_campaign values: launch_benchmark, launch_migration, launch_dev_ws.

jordan: Action items:
- riley: creative mocks (two hero variants) — due Tue 11am
- sam: benchmark post outline + chart placeholders — due Tue 11am
- mia: routing matrix + form copy — due Tue 11am
- ava: bench validation with eng-ml — due Wed noon
- alex: UTM plan + measurement plan — due Wed noon
I'll assemble and run a final pass before Fri review.

notion-bot: Page created: 'Landing copy + webinar hooks — drafts' (https://redwood.notion/example-page)

jordan: Final copy reminder: keep technical specifics for deep-dive docs. Customer-facing copy should surface benefits (cost, latency, reliability, control) and avoid jargon unless tied to a clear benefit. Meeting Fri 9am to review mocks.

riley: On it.

sam: Will share draft slides for benchmark.

mia: Routing sheet incoming.

jordan: Thanks team — small set of focused assets and we can iterate quickly after the first test. :)
